structure.unit: State Authorities, Boards, Commissions, Councils, Foundations and Other Collegial Bodies

law.catch_line: Form and audit of accounts and records

text.section: The accounts and records of the Authority showing the receipt and disbursement of funds from whatever source derived shall be in such form as the Auditor of Public Accounts prescribes.
The accounts and records of the Authority are subject to an annual audit by the Auditor of Public Accounts or his legal representative.
